thread:
Lee: quick postmortem follow-up  we uncovered several recurring pager patterns across svc-auth, svc-pay, and infra-proxy. Need owners, small rollouts, and a verification plan that catches regressions. Keep items short.

Carmen: I'll take svc-pay alerts (pay-5xx-*, pay-latency-*). Plan: tighten aggregation window to 5m for spikes (was 1m), set burst suppression 180s, and run a 24h historical simulation to ensure we don't hide real incidents. Target: PR by Tue, canary Wed.

Devon: I'll handle dedupe policy across infra-proxy and gateway alerts. Proposal: increase dedupe to 10m for flapping TCP errors, but add an "escalate if total_events>5 in 2h" rule so we don't mask persistent failures. Will run a staging test Thu.

Priya: I'll update the incident/runbook to include a "repeat-pattern" checklist (how to flag recurring incidents) and add instructions to tag alerts with "recurring=true" when we see patterns. PR by Wed. Also recommend adding a weekly report for top-20 noisy alerts.

Lee: good. Can we add a lightweight smoke harness for each service before prod roll? Example (svc-pay):

```
# generate controlled spikes against staging pay service
for i in 1 2; do seq 1 120 | xargs -n1 -P40 curl -fsS https://staging.pay/api/health || echo spike; sleep 15; done
```

Carmen: will run that and paste canary stdout + dashboard snapshot in the task.

oncall-bot: created task INFR-3301 "Cross-team: recurring-pager patterns + alert sweep" assigned to Carmen, Devon; due 2026-04-09.

Devon: implementation note: dedupe change needs alert-exporter v1.5 and alert-manager bump. I'll gate on exporter canary passing and include an integration test that simulates 6 short gaps to confirm escalation fires.

Carmen: timeline check  PR Tue, canary Wed, prod Fri with 72h watch. Will include a metric that tracks suppressed->true-positive ratio. If ratio > 0.15 in 24h, auto-rollback.

Priya: for the "repeat-pattern" checklist, items: 1) confirm owner; 2) add recurring tag; 3) add long-window metric (24h); 4) schedule follow-up retro if recurrence >3 in 14d; 5) add action item with ETA. I'll paste checklist in INFR-3301.

Lee: good. Owners summary: Carmen (svc-pay thresholds + canary) Tue/Wed; Devon (dedupe policy + staging tests) Thu; Priya (runbook + recurring checklist) Wed. Add verification notes to the task before close.

Devon: one more safeguard: if dedupe suppresses a P0/P1, force immediate page regardless of suppression. We'll add that to config.

Carmen: acknowledged. I'll also include dashboards for error-rate, latency, and pages-before/after.

oncall-bot: added comment to INFR-3301: "verification checklist required for close: canary logs, dashboards, suppressed->true-positive metric."

Lee: thanks. tagging @incident-review and @platform to keep PM/Support informed. Let's keep changes conservative and observable. End of thread.
